title: Discover context indices before loading large payloads
narrative: Fangore's host memory source must advertise what it can supply before dumping large payloads into a turn. Accepts inspiration requirement 6[^insp-r06]. Related personal-agent freshness/provenance story: `fangore_insp_tool_result_freshness`[^insp-pa-01-provider].
implementation: `ContextProvider` / `StaticContextProvider` expose `index` then `load` with provenance and token estimates.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/context_provider_discovery.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
